# UCDP conflict data

Source record for datasets published by the Uppsala Conflict Data Program.

The UCDP download center states that its datasets are free of charge and
licensed under CC BY 4.0, with citation of the relevant publications required.

## Canonical GED boundary

**UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset (GED) version 25.1** is now stored
canonically under:

`datasets/ucdp-ged-25-1/`

This external record remains intentionally broader than that one canonical
release. UCDP publishes additional conflict datasets and later GED versions,
so the source-level record is still useful.

The current `displacement-risk-lab-dynamodb` repository targets GED 25.1.
Issue #65 will migrate that production ingestion path to the canonical registry
snapshot while preserving this broader UCDP source record.
